# Get-MailboxSizeReport

<!-- Generated by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Edit the script header, not this file. -->

Reports Exchange Online mailbox sizes (and optionally archive sizes) with warning and critical thresholds.

| | |
|---|---|
| Location | `scripts/windows/exchange/Get-MailboxSizeReport.ps1` |
| Platform | Windows (ExchangeOnlineManagement module, Exchange Online) |
| Permissions | Exchange Online role View-Only Recipients (Get-Mailbox) and View-Only Recipients or Mail Recipients (Get-MailboxStatistics) |
| Safety | Read-only |

## When to use

Capacity planning, finding mailboxes near quota, or sizing a migration or archive rollout.

## Description

For all mailboxes, a list of UPNs, or a CSV with a UserPrincipalName column, collects total item size, item count,
last logon / last user action, quotas and (with -IncludeArchive) archive size. Each mailbox is rated OK, Warning or
Critical against -WarningSizeGB and -CriticalSizeGB based on the primary mailbox size.

Output is an HTML report (primary, largest 500 mailboxes shown, Warning/Critical rows highlighted), an optional
CSV with every mailbox (-ExportCsv) and a log file, all in the output folder. The script does not change anything.
It reports sizes at the time of the run only; Exchange Online keeps no size history, so growth is not calculated
(compare the CSVs from two runs to see growth).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-UserPrincipalNames` | String[] | No | Optional list of mailboxes (UPNs) to check. If neither this nor -CsvPath is given, all mailboxes are checked. |
| `-CsvPath` | String | No | Optional input CSV with a UserPrincipalName column listing the mailboxes to check. |
| `-OutputPath` | String | No | Folder for the report, CSV and log. Falls back to $env:TOOLBOX_REPORT_DIR, then prompts. |
| `-CustomerName` | String | No | Optional. Adds a &lt;OutputPath&gt;\&lt;CustomerName&gt; subfolder. |
| `-ExportCsv` | SwitchParameter | No | Also write all mailbox rows to a CSV next to the HTML report. |
| `-IncludeArchive` | SwitchParameter | No | Also collect archive mailbox size and item count for mailboxes with an active archive. |
| `-WarningSizeGB` | Int32 | No | Primary mailbox size in GB at or above which a mailbox is rated Warning. Default 50. |
| `-CriticalSizeGB` | Int32 | No | Primary mailbox size in GB at or above which a mailbox is rated Critical. Default 80. |
| `-SkipExchangeConnect` | SwitchParameter | No | Do not call Connect-ExchangeOnline; use an existing session. |

## Examples

```powershell
.\Get-MailboxSizeReport.ps1 -OutputPath D:\Reports
```

```powershell
.\Get-MailboxSizeReport.ps1 -IncludeArchive -WarningSizeGB 40 -CriticalSizeGB 90 -ExportCsv -CustomerName Contoso -OutputPath D:\Reports
```
